author: marta-dev
body: After upgrading from 2.2.1 to 2.3.0 the app crashes immediately on launch with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'config')` in SettingsStore. Reproducible on Windows 11 and Ubuntu 24.04. Downgrading to 2.2.1 fixes it. This is blocking our whole team from working.
title: App crashes on startup after upgrading to v2.3.0

author: nightowl42
body: It would be great to have a dark mode option for the dashboard. Many of us use the app at night and the bright UI is hard on the eyes. A toggle in settings plus following the OS preference would be ideal.
title: Feature request: dark mode for the dashboard

author: datafan
body: I looked through the docs and the settings menu but I can't find a way to export my project data as CSV. Is this supported? If yes, where is the option? Using version 2.2.0 on macOS.
title: How do I export my project data as CSV?

author: firstcontrib
body: The README still says to run `npm install -g oldname` but the package was renamed two releases ago. New users following the README get a 404 from npm. The correct command is `npm install -g newname`. Also the screenshots show the old UI.
title: README installation instructions are outdated

author: ops-lead
body: Since last week, roughly 1 in 5 uploads of files over 10MB fails with a 500 error. Smaller files work fine. Server logs show `PayloadTooLarge` warnings right before the failures even though our plan allows 50MB. Started after the March infra migration. Affecting paying customers on our account.
title: API returns 500 intermittently when uploading files larger than 10MB
